title: Leider Fehlerhaft
body:
Leider werden Termine mit dem KI Assistenten nicht immer zuverlässig eingetragen. Außerdem antwortet der Assistent gelegentlich in Dänisch statt in Deutsch. Sonst wäre es eine tolle App. Sehr schade und für mich auch sehr anstrengend, dass die Ressourcen nur in englischer Sprache verfügbar sind.
Nachtrag: Nach dem letzten Update werden leider alle Termine, die mit dem Assistenten erstellt wurden, in englischer Sprache eingetragen. Bitte dringend beheben, ich habe ein Jahresabo und kann die App dadurch kaum nutzen.
author: Querceus

title: Unfocused
body:
For an app that is supposed to make chaotic people more focused and productive this things is surprisingly avoid of structure.

The onboarding is terrible with selecting a few tasks and it then dropping you into the app with ZERO GUIDANCE of what to do. After playing around with it it’s basically a todo list with some cute animations and an AI that is dumber than a rock. It could not even remove a morning routine that was useless after telling it I don’t need it cause it’s 5 PM.

I then went ahead and tried the morning routine for fun at 5 PM and after I completed all the tasks the button sends you back to the timer screen where you can start a new senseless timer instead of putting you back to the app.

All features like the todo list and the AI are accessible even without premium or any free trial making it impossible to even know what premium even does let alone the buy screen is spending more time listing pointless awards instead of showing you the features.

App of the year 2025? Absolute joke and this award can no longer be taken seriously!

title: Gute App, leider einige buggs
body:
Ich habe jetzt einige Zeit Tiimo getestet weil ich eine gute Todo app suche. Ich mag wirklich alle features der app und das design ist sehr gut.

Allerdings gibt es einige buggs die das Erlebnis etwas zerstören:
1. Ich muss die App nach circa 1-2 Stunden inaktivität neustarten weil die Todos nicht geladen werden.
2. Die KI antworten mir in 80% der Fälle nicht
3. Obwohl mein Google Kalender im Webplaner verknüpft ist, werden die Termine nicht synchronisiert

title: Meh
body:
I like the idea behind this app, but there are a few things missing that turn me away.
Planned activities start on their own which is perfect, but if I start another activity because I take a break, planned activities from calendars stop and vanish completely. Also it would be nice if it would sync in two directions, so if I add an activity it also shows in the calendar and not only in tiimo app.
Browser app is available but it doesn’t sync all activities and routines with the ios app, which defeats the purpose, but in browser is the only way to see the whole week at a glance.
author: Mkatzl

title: Great idea, buggy realisation
body:
I love the app - in theory.

As an autistic person, I really appreciate Tiimo for creating this visual scheduling app with beautiful interface (esp. compared to similar apps on the market).
It would be an irreplaceable asset in my life IF it weren't for the bugs!
The phone widget does not sync reliably if the app is not opened regularly. 
The watch app is even worse and does not work reliably -period.

For people who have enough executive functioning ability to open up their scheduling app regularly anyways this shouldn't be too much of a problem.
For me and other people who have exactly the problem that they struggle with planning and starting, an app that relies on the prime initiative of their users does not do a lot.

I originally got the app to get reminders on my watch e.g. when I am in focus mode and not checking my phone for hours. 
Since the idea is still great and good things need support, I will keep paying for the app for a bit and see how it will develop over the next months.
But right now it is not the aid it should be.

(Tiimos customer support is great, but naturally they can't fix those major technical issues)
